number_oracle.caveat: Rust core::fmt is Grisu3-derived, as is V8's fast path: this is an independent IMPLEMENTATION, not an independent ALGORITHM. The digit COUNT is taken from the foreign renderer and the digits are re-derived by exact ROUND_HALF_EVEN, so a shared shortest-length bug would survive. An exact minimal-length oracle is a ruled, unbuilt cutover gate.
